arguments.rule_content:
title: DNS Tunneling Data Exfiltration Detection
id: dns-tunneling-exfil-2026a
description: "Detects large volume of DNS TXT record queries indicative of data exfiltration"
product: splunk
severity: critical
risk: 91
date: 2026/04/09
status: experimental
author: SOC Primavera
license: Copyright 2026
falsepositives: ["Legitimate high-volume DNS applications"]
references: ["Internal Incident INC-AP9-V4"]
detection:
  selection:
    EventType:
      - DNS_QUERY
    QueryType:
      - TXT
    DestinationIp:
      - "10.0.7.*"
    QueryLength|bytes:
      - ">= 100"
  timeframe: 5m
  condition: count(selection) > 300
  outliers:
    ratio:
      by: SourceIp
      field: QueryLength|bytes
      over: 5m
      method: median_absolute_deviation
    value:
      - ">= 3"
  threshold: 3
  cardinality:
    field: SourceIp
    value: 1
  filter:
    not:
      - QueryName:
          - ".corp.local"
          - ".internal"
  threshold: 3
  outliers:
    ratio:
      by: SourceIp
      field: QueryLength|bytes
      over: 5m
      method: median_absolute_deviation
    value:
      - ">= 3"
  threshold: 3
  outliers:
    ratio:
      by: SourceIp
      field: QueryLength|bytes
      over: 5m
      method: median_absolute_deviation
    value:
      - ">= 3"
  threshold: 3
  outliers:
    ratio:
      by: SourceIp
      field: QueryLength|bytes
      over: 5m
      method: median_absolute_deviation
    value:
      - ">= 3"
  threshold: 3
